hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { dotnet format MartianRobots.slnx --verify-no-changes -v q && dotnet test --nologo -v q; } 1>&2 || exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking format and tests before commit
